'''2014 Worlds Reset Beta Jake Nelson DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jake Nelson]] at [[2014 World Championship Reset Beta]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Jake Nelson]]
* '''Event:''' [[2014 World Championship Reset Beta]]
* '''Stage:''' Results
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
